resources.string: Where transactions are broadcast and the chain is read.
It learns nothing about you that you did not already know.
It sees your transactions but not where they came from.

It sees your address and your transactions together. Dandelion++ hides a transaction\'s origin from the rest of the network — it cannot hide it from the node you handed it to. It can also lie: your balance and the payments you are shown are its account of the chain, which nothing here checks against a second source. Running your own is the fix for both.
This one is reached without encryption, so anyone on the network between here and it can do the same — read it, or change it.
No wallet key on this device
This install finished setup before the app kept the wallet, so there is nothing to scan with. Waiting will not fix it — restore from a backup, or clear the app\'s data and set up again.
The node above answered, so this is the wallet\'s own read of the chain rather than the connection.

Your balance is only what has been read so far.
This wallet is scanning from the beginning of the chain, which takes far longer than it needs to if it was made recently.
